new_value:
The coefficient of variation is equal to the standard deviation of returns divided by the mean return.

Mean return = (17.0% + 12.2% + 3.9% – 8.4%) / 4 = 6.175%

| Year | Return | (R – 6.175%)^2 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 17.0% | 117.18 |
| 2 | 12.2% | 36.30 |
| 3 | 3.9% | 5.18 |
| 4 | –8.4% | 212.43 |
| Sum | | 371.09 |

Sample standard deviation = [371.09 / (4 – 1)]^0.5 = 11.12%
Coefficient of variation = 11.12% / 6.175% = 1.80

We need to calculate of probability weighted average payoff.

Since the probability of the coin landing on its edge is 0.02, the probability of each of the other two events is 0.49. The expected payoff is: (0.02 × $50) + (0.49 × $1) + (0.49 × $2) = $2.47.

|---|---|---|---|
| Edge | 2 / 100 = 2% | $50 | 2% × $50 |
| Heads | 49% | $1 | 49% × $1 |
| Tails | 49% | $2 | 49% × $2 |
| Expected Payoff = ∑ Probability × Payoff | | | $2.47 |
